newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine readies to pick firm for first Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine readies to pick firm for first Eurobonds.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank has given President Leonid Kuchma a list of prospective companies to act as agents in the country's first Eurobond issue in early 1997, a top bank official said on Tuesday.

"Officially the tender to issue the foreign bonds has not been announced, but interested companies and banks have made proposals to the central bank," said Oleh Rybachuk, chief of the foreign relations department.
"A list of these companies has been given to the president," he said.
Kuchma's office is expected to choose the firm.
The company winning the tender would be required to arrange a rating process for Ukraine, Rybachuk added.
The government has announced that it plans to issue Eurobonds by the end of the first quarter of 1997, totalling about $250 million.
